scope: User-authorised live machine-label rollout and preparation of the actual-human native board test. Subsequent successful answer/review is recorded in native-board-live.json.

preflight.scheduleDefinitions: paused or expired; none activated or changed by rollout

boardTest.state: completed after actual-human native board answer and acceptance
boardTest.requiredAnswerSource: terminal: conversation ID and dialog:human-board: message ID

limitations: Actual-human board answer/review is recorded separately in native-board-live.json.
Orderly deployment restarts do not certify crash-during-execution recovery.
Three Relay nodes on one host are not physical two-machine evidence.
The manually started local node remains a foreground daemon, not a newly installed persistent user service.
